The text says 'Decreasing the opacity... can create sketches... Fig. 7 shows a black and white sketch... by using a white sketch color and making nonvolumetric silhouettes transparent.' This implies the transparency is a result of the opacity decrease technique, not a direct color modification step. Thus, the claim misrepresents the causal relationship described in the evidence.
